description_en: Queries the list of V-series edge all-in-one devices bound to an image search application instance
description_zh: 调用该接口，查询以图搜图应用实例绑定的V系列边缘一体机列表
name: QueryPictureSearchAiboxes

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html接口查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中，每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number to start displaying from in the response. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

If the public instance does not have an ID, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。

如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:
200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, refer to [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

PageData.description_en: The list of V-series edge all-in-one devices

IotId.description_en: The device ID of the V-series edge all-in-one device
IotId.description_zh: V系列边缘一体机对应的设备ID

NickName.description_en: The device alias of the V-series edge all-in-one device
NickName.description_zh: V系列边缘一体机对应的设备别名

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in the response
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: Specified parameter CurrentPage is not valid.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
